proof.criterion: The ygo pin the merge brings is the one that makes a replica's replay match the room: the reviewer's 3,000-run replay harness finds no divergence at this head's pin with Dispatch's own copy option.
proof.surface: The reviewer's ygoexp harness (dispatch://INFRA-707/artifact/ygo-replay-harness-tar-gz; I copied the issue volume's source into a directory of my own and edited only my copy), 3,000 seeds of 40 random YText insert/format/delete steps, comparing CaptureSnapshot and ToDelta of the live document and of a replica replayed as renderedReplica.takeLocked does
proof.command: In my copy's go.mod, the replace line set to the head's pin, github.com/sjawhar/ygo v1.54.1-sami.3 (packages/envoy/go.mod:162); then `GOMAXPROCS=4 GOMEMLIMIT=4GiB GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go run .` from ygoexp (room and peer edits) and from ygoexp/localonly (room edits only), first as the reviewer wrote them, then with Dispatch's own replica option added to the `rep = crdt.New()` line of both: crdt.WithFormatCleanup(false), which is what newDocumentCopy sets (tree.go:308)
proof.observed: With the option, both workloads give `runs with state divergence: 0 delta divergence: 0 state-div runs where replica ran its own cleanup before: 0 delta-div runs likewise: 0`. That is the pass the reviewer named, and it is the first run of this harness at this pin.
proof.negativeControl: The same pin WITHOUT the option, which is ygo's default: mixed 700 state / 41 delta, local-only 1243 / 329, every one of them a run where the replica had committed its own cleanup transaction first. Those are the same numbers the reviewer measured at v1.54.1-sami.1, so the new pin alone does not fix the divergence - the pin plus Dispatch's cleanup-off copy does, which is exactly what #2604 and this pull request's newDocumentCopy do together.
